methods.label: Expand to a common factorial
methods.explanation:
Expanding only as far as \(9!\) reveals a common factor: \(11!=11\cdot10\cdot9!\) and \(10!=10\cdot9!\). Since \(9!>0\), we may cancel it to obtain
\[
\frac{11!-10!}{9!}
=\frac{(110-10)9!}{9!}
=100.
\]
Thus the value is \(100\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
